verdict.rationale: The trademark apply page states the filing wall up front: create a USPTO.gov account with multifactor authentication and verify your identity before you can log in to TEAS or Trademark Center. The same page says the one-time verification takes under 15 minutes online, offers a paper alternative, and lets you preview forms without logging in. Accepted payment methods are also published in advance. Missing for 10: equivalent explicit identity-proofing disclosure for Patent Center (evidence only says registered users are needed), the specific documents or credentials required for verification, and independent or hands-on corroboration that no extra walls surface mid-flow.
